Objective: Independent review of design.md (and impact-analysis.md on brownfield slices) against the SPEC: every acceptance criterion reachable, error contract explicit, data model and migration reversible, threat model covering every new entry point, smallest structure that satisfies the SPEC. MUST-FIX or HIGH routes back to design; otherwise the locked set proceeds to plan_lock.

Prior step note: Rework 59c8762 answers design review DR-01 and DR-02; see design.md Review response. The functional overlay sets it false (one line, granted by the lead at cec7032), so no shared context ever purges and your overlap cannot arise. AC-7, AC-8 and AC-13 enable it in their own closed contexts. No shipped test file changes. Probe A8off (output-5.txt): 0 runs in 11 s past the next 00:10Z. In-suite proof: ClickPurgeHoldJourneyTest in the default context. DR-02: AC-4 is asserted on the failure-analysis event only, and the A4 row is corrected (root=warn hid the Hikari and Flyway INFO URL lines). Requirements was asked at 17:52Z to note the hold under rules 1 and 3 and the overlay line under AC-14, in passing.
